commentary: With market breadth sitting at an anemic 36 and the deterministic gate pegged at WEAK, William O'Neil's market-direction discipline mandates extreme capital protection. Even as the benchmark index reclaims 23,000, narrow participation and persistent institutional distribution increase the failure rate of emerging breakouts. Stan Weinstein's stage principles caution against aggressive long exposure when underlying participation lacks breadth. In this defensive regime, Mark Minervini's progressive exposure rule dictates waiting for certified market sponsorship. Traders should sit tight, reserve capital exclusively for elite setups demonstrating certified quarterly earnings acceleration and volume confirmation, and strictly avoid chasing laggards until broader market accumulation confirms an authoritative Stage 2 expansion.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

21STCENMGM.technical: SEPA Trend Template is intact with price clearing prior 20-session highs and setting fresh 52-week highs above rising 21, 50, and 200 averages on 2.08x volume. Relative strength is constructive, but micro-cap volatility requires stringent execution.
21STCENMGM.fundamental: Turned profitable in Q1 FY27 with sharp revenue expansion to ₹10 crore, yet historical profitability remains irregular. While zero debt offers solvency stability, the lack of multi-quarter institutional earnings stability keeps fundamental qualification partial.
21STCENMGM.risk: Fails on a breakdown below the 47.48 stop level, violating the breakout pivot and 21-EMA dynamic support.

63MOONS.technical: Trading constructively within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot (950.95), holding firm above ascending 21, 50, and 200 moving averages. Two aligned swing lows provide a clean base, with positive MACD momentum supporting an impending pivot test.
63MOONS.fundamental: Software operations show marginal revenue growth of 2.3% YoY in Q1 FY27. While virtually debt-free with strong cash reserves, modest return on equity (1.5%) and historical NSEL-related liabilities fail CANSLIM's high-octane growth thresholds.
63MOONS.risk: Fails if price violates the 841 swing-low stop, invalidating the double-bottom pivot and 50-DMA cushion.

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Forming a base above the 200-day moving average, showing constructive three-up action off the 21-EMA and RSI at 61. However, heavy overhead supply and lagging relative strength persist below the 114.91 resistance trigger.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Topline fell 56.3% YoY and profit dropped 25.5% YoY in Q1 FY27. Ultra-thin operating margins below 3% and poor three-year return on equity (~3%) violate basic O'Neil C-and-A CANSLIM requirements.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Hard stop at 103.8. Setup fails if price loses 21-EMA support and breaches double-bottom pivot lows.

AARTIPHARM.technical: Textbook Stage 2 continuation with price above all core moving averages, registering a high-volume double bottom base emergence on 6.15x average volume. Breakout strength and RSI at 59 indicate strong institutional accumulation.
AARTIPHARM.fundamental: High-conviction CANSLIM candidate. Q2 FY27 revenue grew 46.8% YoY while PAT jumped 180% with EBITDA margins widening to 22.2%. Scaling CDMO order book and dominant Xanthine capacity additions drive sustained operational leverage.
AARTIPHARM.risk: Invalidated if price fails at the 1,003.4 pivot and breaches the 918.41 stop on distribution.

ABDL.technical: Consolidating in a constructive double-bottom handle above rising 21, 50, and 200 moving averages. Reclaim off the 21-EMA with RSI at 54 confirms technical structure, but requires volume expansion through 767.67.
ABDL.fundamental: Delivered record volume of 10M cases with 15.8% revenue growth in Q2 FY27, but net profit grew only 9.7% amid supply chain headwinds. Net debt rose to ₹1,273 crore (2.2x EBITDA), capping fundamental qualification.
ABDL.risk: Thesis collapses if price loses the 706.26 base shelf, invalidating the 21-EMA support.

ACUTAAS.technical: Pristine Minervini SEPA breakout pattern clearing 20-day consolidations to fresh 52-week highs on 4.06x 20-day volume. High relative strength, perfectly stacked moving averages, and exceptional volume dry-up before expansion demonstrate institutional sponsorship.
ACUTAAS.fundamental: Grade-A CANSLIM leader. Q2 FY27 PAT jumped 71.4% YoY on 42.7% revenue growth, driving EBITDA margins above 40%. Ahead-of-schedule launch of South Korean semiconductor chemical operations and raised FY27 guidance underpin dominant earnings power.
ACUTAAS.risk: Thesis fails if price suffers a high-volume false breakout reversing below the 3,600.26 pivot support.
